'''Battle Droid Defender of Tatooine''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] GeoCities site.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Battle Droid]]
* '''Published:''' by 9 July 2000 (Corellian Engineering Corporation)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut|Premiere-L-tatooineobiwanshut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Defender of Tatooine
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE OWHut BattleDroid LS 2000 CEC.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This deck is simple use All My Urchins with Order to Engage, while you retreive force from the Celebration. Use the monks to help force drains on tatooine.
